pins.MODULE.bazel:
module(
    name = "burrow",
    version = "0.0.0",
)

# Documentation toolchain pins match Hovel c461ba282a8aecc7aa3a079a4613bf5e2640c388.
bazel_dep(name = "aspect_rules_js", version = "3.2.2")
bazel_dep(name = "rules_nodejs", version = "6.7.5")
bazel_dep(name = "rules_python", version = "2.2.0")

python = use_extension("@rules_python//python/extensions:python.bzl", "python")
python.toolchain(python_version = "3.12")

node = use_extension("@rules_nodejs//nodejs:extensions.bzl", "node")
node.toolchain(node_version_from_nvmrc = "//docs/site:.nvmrc")
use_repo(node, "nodejs_toolchains")

pnpm = use_extension("@aspect_rules_js//npm:extensions.bzl", "pnpm")
pnpm.pnpm(pnpm_version_from = "//docs/site:package.json")
use_repo(pnpm, "pnpm")

npm = use_extension("@aspect_rules_js//npm:extensions.bzl", "npm")
npm.npm_translate_lock(
    name = "npm",
    npmrc = "//docs/site:.npmrc",
    pnpm_lock = "//docs/site:pnpm-lock.yaml",
    run_lifecycle_hooks = False,
)
use_repo(npm, "npm")

# Pinned runtime v0.4.2 (c461ba282a8a); GitHub asset digest.
# SDK source is pinned separately below; no runtime/SDK changes through a4cbfdf.
http_file = use_repo_rule("@bazel_tools//tools/build_defs/repo:http.bzl", "http_file")

# pipx 1.17.6 (MIT), upstream standalone zipapp and GitHub asset SHA256.
# Test tool only; Burrow's wheel has no Python runtime dependencies.
http_file(
    name = "pipx",
    urls = ["https://github.com/pypa/pipx/releases/download/1.17.6/pipx.pyz"],
    sha256 = "63b10dd9a15a57ec4066e29388d1e83565be4b127bd1cf6e3f150fcc39ded8b2",
    downloaded_file_path = "pipx.pyz",
)

http_file(
    name = "hovel_linux_wheel",
    downloaded_file_path = "hovel.whl",
    sha256 = "7edccdabe04e30098e417d27ab48064c11a8612149124b7df0797251e88a0933",
    urls = ["https://github.com/vibepwners/hovel/releases/download/v0.4.2/hovel-0.4.2-py3-none-manylinux_2_28_x86_64.whl"],
)

# Real full-screen SSH acceptance only: Alpine 3.24 x86_64 Vim executable.
# Alpine aports b7c31805c49a6e75b725aee8601e2e99e1d693e9; Vim license.
# The lab uses -u NONE -i NONE --noplugin, without runtime scripts or xxd.
http_file(
    name = "shell_lab_vim",
    downloaded_file_path = "vim.apk",
    sha256 = "6677af51cdce462afaf06af353acfe059b4a3c68c4257a539121c3ce46d25c68",
    urls = ["https://dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine/v3.24/community/x86_64/vim-9.2.1091-r0.apk"],
)

# Dropbear interoperability fixture only, Alpine 3.24 x86_64 (MIT).
# aports e56a1d711fb2dd69206223dcdfd609d91d40ad02; shared libraries ISC.
# Executed inside the digest-pinned OpenSSH lab image, never installed on hosts.
http_file(
    name = "chain_lab_dropbear",
    downloaded_file_path = "dropbear.apk",
    sha256 = "cba11fe37aa85d7259ae44d494544e869bb58879e35124d0ba33b32c3b1201d7",
    urls = ["https://dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine/v3.24/main/x86_64/dropbear-2026.91-r0.apk"],
)
http_file(
    name = "chain_lab_utmps",
    downloaded_file_path = "utmps.apk",
    sha256 = "497f0f1cb51f0e6c1acc338fded0dc7722b1d43ea17bdb749f0d556794f8b2d8",
    urls = ["https://dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine/v3.24/main/x86_64/utmps-libs-0.1.3.3-r0.apk"],
)
http_file(
    name = "chain_lab_skalibs",
    downloaded_file_path = "skalibs.apk",
    sha256 = "3301f6ccbeaea49cdd966c7e636898a8612fb8fe964a15f24f6d204b3944c3f3",
    urls = ["https://dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine/v3.24/main/x86_64/skalibs-libs-2.15.0.0-r0.apk"],
)

# Disposable external SDK proof, pinned to the research baseline.
bazel_dep(name = "rules_go", version = "0.61.1")
bazel_dep(name = "gazelle", version = "0.51.3")
bazel_dep(name = "rules_pkg", version = "1.2.0")

go_sdk = use_extension("@rules_go//go:extensions.bzl", "go_sdk")
go_sdk.download(name = "burrow_go_sdk", version = "1.26.5")
use_repo(go_sdk, "burrow_go_sdk")

go_deps = use_extension("@gazelle//:extensions.bzl", "go_deps")
go_deps.from_file(go_mod = "//core/prototype_sdk:go.mod")
use_repo(go_deps, "com_github_charmbracelet_colorprofile", "com_github_charmbracelet_x_ansi", "com_github_charmbracelet_x_term", "com_github_charmbracelet_x_vt", "com_github_pkg_sftp", "land_charm_bubbles_v2", "land_charm_bubbletea_v2", "land_charm_lipgloss_v2", "org_golang_x_crypto", "org_golang_x_sys")
use_repo(go_deps, "com_github_charmbracelet_ultraviolet", "land_charm_huh_v2", "land_charm_glamour_v2")

http_archive = use_repo_rule("@bazel_tools//tools/build_defs/repo:http.bzl", "http_archive")

# Ruff 0.16.3 (MIT), matching Hovel 541e78ada0af's sdk/python/uv.lock.
# Linux amd64 release asset; SHA256 from Astral's GitHub release metadata.
http_archive(
    name = "ruff",
    urls = ["https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/download/0.16.3/ruff-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz"],
    sha256 = "7ab3b978d2c0b1c96b2323d4e5c4f35284ae1cdf35d2f7399595c74c805f5fa3",
    strip_prefix = "ruff-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu",
    build_file_content = "exports_files([\"ruff\"])",
)

# Workflow syntax/expression checks: rhysd/actionlint v1.7.12, MIT;
# SHA256 from the upstream GitHub release asset (Linux amd64 operator baseline).
http_archive(
    name = "actionlint",
    urls = ["https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/releases/download/v1.7.12/actionlint_1.7.12_linux_amd64.tar.gz"],
    sha256 = "8aca8db96f1b94770f1b0d72b6dddcb1ebb8123cb3712530b08cc387b349a3d8",
    build_file_content = "exports_files([\"actionlint\"])",
)

http_archive(
    name = "hovel_sdk",
    build_file = "//core/prototype_sdk:hovel.BUILD.bazel",
    patch_cmds = ["rm sdk/go/hovel/BUILD.bazel"],
    sha256 = "9080e5060787f4ba5ee6715611e10112af2af316318369b748c9f566c1f3b6e9",
    strip_prefix = "hovel-a4cbfdf7769a9551695088c11061e3cabc368e07",
    type = "tar.gz",
    urls = ["https://codeload.github.com/vibepwners/hovel/tar.gz/a4cbfdf7769a9551695088c11061e3cabc368e07"],
)

provenance.workload: one approved local SSH master, one retained shell and one TUI attachment; raw remote dd bs=1 with terminal echo disabled; sequential harmless bytes, no background output or faults; TUI controller followed by CLI controller with TUI observer
provenance.clock: CLOCK_MONOTONIC ns, same boot across processes
provenance.observation: begin immediately before PTY write or CLI Popen; visible at decoded VT cells; existing decoder uses up to 50ms wait/drain polling; CLI return observed independently at decoder-loop cadence
provenance.correlation: one outstanding byte, one shell; serial monotonic windows and frontend/owner PIDs; phases overlap and are not additive; no private input or screen content in evidence
provenance.timeouts: 15s per interaction, 20s connection transitions, 60s CLI setup, 1800s whole lab
